summary: Uses NVIDIA Maxine Video Effects AI segmentation to output a monochrome foreground/background key, commonly used with Matte TOP or other compositing nodes to replace a webcam-style background.

key_params.name: segment
key_params.note: Treat chairs as foreground or Background in the matte.

key_params.name: format
key_params.note: Common TOP pixel format for the monochrome output image.

common_gotchas: Official docs mark this TOP as Windows-only and requiring a 20/30/40/50 series NVIDIA RTX card.
The required Video Effects SDK models must be downloaded separately for the target GPU.
Do not combine this feature with ZED device workflows in one project because of TensorRT version conflicts.
The background engine requires at least 512x288 video input.
The AI key lags the source by multiple frames; delay the source image, for example with Cache TOP, before compositing.
key_concepts: Uses NVIDIA Maxine AI segmentation to separate a foreground person from the background.
Outputs a monochrome key image for Matte TOP or other compositing workflows.
The model is tuned for webcam-like single-person footage rather than arbitrary scenes.
AI processing introduces frame latency that should be matched by delaying the source image.
